# QnALog 1.6.11

## Highlights

- **Errata notes**: each voice note can have its own errata note in `QnALog/勘误表/`, linked to the original note with a wiki link. It has three sections:
  - **替换 (Replace)**: one `wrong => right` pair per line. These are applied to the transcript before organizing and again to the generated text.
  - **噪音 (Noise)**: text that does not belong to the recording, such as stray sounds or content the model invented. It is excluded from organizing; one paragraph per entry.
  - **说明 (Notes)**: free-form constraints that are passed to the model.
- Reorganize, derived versions and clean copies all read the errata note, so a correction made once no longer reappears after regenerating. The replace rules are applied by code; noise and notes are instructions to the model and are not guaranteed.
- Select text in a note and choose **Correct selected text** or **Mark selected text as noise** from the editor menu or the command palette. The correction dialog asks only for the wrong word and the right word, so it also works on mobile. The wrong word must have at least 2 characters.
- Note list context menu: new **Open errata** item (creates the errata note if it does not exist). The menu is regrouped: failed-transcription retry, view, add recordings, correct and regenerate, topics and export, then rename and delete.
- The previous "Correct misrecognized text" action no longer rewrites the whole note and transcript; it now records the correction in the errata note.

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. Existing notes are not rewritten. An errata note is created only when you add a correction or open one. The correction is applied to the note body immediately, but the original transcript block is not changed; the correction takes effect in generated text after you reorganize, regenerate a derived version or generate a clean copy. Errata notes are excluded from the note list, related notes and knowledge extraction.
